title: Italian Apple Lasagna
description: A creative twist on the classic lasagna, with layers of pillowy dough, sweet apples, and rich Italian flavors.
instructions: Roll out the lasagna dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch (6 mm).
In a large bowl, mix together the ricotta cheese, egg, and sugar until smooth.
In a separate bowl, mix together the sliced apples and cinnamon.
Spread a layer of the ricotta mixture onto the dough, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border around the edges.
Top with a layer of apple slices, followed by another layer of dough.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of dough on top.
Brush the top layer with melted butter and bake for 35-40 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
